notes.title: Cutscene Updates + Extended Ending
notes.content:
Ho-Ho-Ho!   This first update contains minor bug fixes, improves art during certain cutscenes, and adds several new and extended sequences to the game, a full list of which can be found below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36229484/427d4080402d0ac3f277e593a9842160ca68add9.png

New Scenes

 The "Naughty" Mrs. Claus romance sequence has been extended and elaborated upon, with new dialogue and updated art.
 Additionally the transition from said sequence to the following scene with Santa has been completely redone from scratch.
 A bonus scene with Santa has been added to the games ending following your battle with the Krampus, expanding upon and making explicit activities which were previously just hinted at.



Bug Fixes

 Updated UI to position the 'Skip' and 'Fullscreen' buttons lower on the screen.
 Fixed a bug where Justin began floating above the bottom of the screen for some users following Larry's re-entry to sequence immediately prior to Mrs. Claus' second scene.
 Several minor typo fixes.
